title: Add CLAUDE.md for Claude Code agent integration
body:
Project system prompts exist for GitHub Copilot (`.github/copilot-instructions.md`) but Claude Code has no equivalent configuration.

### Changes

- **`CLAUDE.md`** — Root-level file auto-discovered by Claude Code CLI. Contains the same architectural context as copilot-instructions: prime directives, monorepo structure, protocol domains, kernel standards, coding patterns, context routing rules, and references to `skills/` and `.github/prompts/` for domain-specific context. Adds a quick-reference section for build/test commands (`pnpm build`, `pnpm test`, etc.) since Claude Code operates as a terminal agent.
- **`.github/copilot-instructions.md`** — Added sync note referencing `CLAUDE.md` so maintainers keep both files aligned.
- **`CHANGELOG.md`** — Documented the addition under `[Unreleased]`.

### How it works

Claude Code automatically reads `CLAUDE.md` at the repo root on launch — no additional configuration needed:

```bash
# Just run claude in the repo directory
cd objectstack-ai/framework
claude
# → CLAUDE.md is loaded as project context automatically
```
